resolved.name: Pizza Box Liner Brown 9"
resolved.how: befoodsonline catalogue, 2026-08-15: listed "Pizza Box Liner Brown 9\" 228x228 200's Ej Eco". Cross-checked against Gulli's pizza box inserts at $0.11055 ea — same product class, same price, so the count is right rather than merely plausible.

resolved.name: Potato Cocktail
resolved.how: not the code alone: POTCOBX — the SAME Cocktail potato in box form — is already chef-confirmed at 20000 g, and FFT's '20' convention is chef-confirmed on PCW20BG and OBL20BG. $1.925/kg against the same potato's box at $2.475/kg: a bag cheaper than a box, the expected direction.

resolved.name: Pears Green
resolved.was: Lightspeed cost-book entry named [kg] but priced $0.65 with unit 'ea'
resolved.now: use the suppliers, not the cost book
resolved.how: Zak: don't use Lightspeed for pears. Our own invoices settle it and BOTH readings are real — Fresh Fruit Team PGKG sells Pears Green by the KILOGRAM (basis per_kg, uom 'Kilogram'): $4.40, $4.40, $3.96/kg across three deliveries. Select Fresh PGRE sells PEAR GREEN EACH at $0.40 x2. The Lightspeed $0.65 matches neither and is a stale BO export.

flags.name: Mushroom Button
flags.issue: $44.00 read as ONE box, so unusable in a recipe. Its B-grade sibling MSHB2 is chef-confirmed at a 4000 g box from the same supplier with the same 'Box' uom; at 4000 g this is $11.00/kg against B-grade's $8.25/kg, which is the right relationship. NOT applied: the box size is inferred from the sibling, not stated anywhere, and A and B grade could ship different boxes.
flags.suggested_fix: Confirm the A-grade box weight on the next delivery — if 4 kg, pin 4000 g.

flags.name: Herb Chives 5-6 Mkt Bnch
flags.issue: $19.00-$22.00 priced as ONE bunch, but the name says the market bunch holds 5-6. At 5.5 that is ~$4/bunch, against FFT HCBCH at $2.42 and Select Fresh's own HCHI at $3.00 — so ~$4 is plausible but 5 vs 6 changes it by 20% and nothing on the invoice says which.
flags.suggested_fix: Ask Select Fresh whether the market bunch is 5 or 6. Not guessed.

flags.name: BRL / BROCE / SBCH
flags.issue: One supplier code carrying two unrelated product names (Broccolini vs Radiccio; Broccolini vs Cocktail (Box); Red Long vs Shallot). Not the dropped-word artefact fixed at source today — these are different products, so either FFT reuses the code or the parser stitched a description from the wrong neighbouring row. Cost history for these codes is mixing two products.
flags.suggested_fix: Confirm with FFT which product each code belongs to.

note: Three of the outstanding flags are closed. The B&E liner was confirmed off the supplier's own catalogue; the FFT potato off a chef-confirmed sibling of the same product; the pear off our own invoices rather than the Lightspeed cost book, which is stale. Both pack fixes made things CHEAPER — they were over-stating cost (a carton price read as one unit), so nothing downstream was ever flattered. What is left needs a supplier to answer, not code: an A-grade mushroom box weight, a chives bunch count, and three FFT codes that carry two products each.
